## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Identify the owning component or study.

## Verification

List exact commands and results, including skips, missing prerequisites and checks not run.
Distinguish synthetic tests, saved-byte integrity and research validation where applicable.

## Research or publication impact

If applicable, link the study protocol, new run or presentation revision and explicit
publication IDs. Explain data/version pins or navigation changes. Completed runs,
released datasets and publication identities must remain preserved.
